title: Magic 8 Chat
description: A fun and portable magic 8 ball inside your Minecraft chat!
body:
Struggle making decisions? Want to know your future? Or your friend's? Well the Magic 8 Chat is just for you!\
Ask any Yes/No question, for example, "Will I become the richest person in the server?" (It doesn't matter how you do it – In your head, in the chat, out loud – Whatever you want!) Then just type /trigger shake and it will then give you a random response from a list of many custom-made ones, for example "Don't count on it"!\
![Magic 8 Chat](https://i.postimg.cc/JnKH5XQK/2026-05-05-18-13-11.png)
You can ask as many questions as you want, and you don't need admin to do it, so any player in a server can "shake" the Magic 8 Chat.\
It also only shows the responses for you, so if for whatever reason you don't want people to see what you got (for example if it was the exact opposite of what you wanted to get) they won't be able to see it unless you show them the message yourself.\

_Note: To disable the trigger message before the 8 Chat's response disable the send_command_feedback gamerule._
